source.manualTitle: Insignia NS-TDRE75W1 / NS-TDRG75W1 Vented Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before accessing internal components.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service test mode entered. Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service test entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: E4 behavior
steps.body: E4 logs at end of cycle: control runs timed drying without humidity sensor. Clothes may finish wet until code is reviewed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Control runs whole cycle with timed drying; error logged at end.

steps.title: Bench humidity sensor CN10
steps.body: Disconnect power. Humidity sensor at CN10 pins 1–4 (HUM). Check harness for damage at drum moisture bars.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Humidity sensor at CN10 pins 1–4 (HUM). Check harness for damage at drum moisture bars.

steps.title: Humidity sensor / harness continuity
steps.body: Does CN10 humidity circuit show continuity (not open) and bars are clean with no corrosion?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Does CN10 humidity circuit show continuity (not open) and bars are clean with no corrosion?

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace humidity sensor assembly or CN10 harness.

steps.title: Replace humidity sensor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace humidity sensor at CN10; clean bars; retest auto-dry cycle.

steps.title: Humidity path verified
steps.oemOutcome: Humidity sensor and CN10 harness OK — E4 should not recur.
